data.name: CheckBoxDetectGrayImage.ToolTip
data.value:
Automatically detect if the live video image becomes gray due to error, and re-initialize the camera.
In some cases the automatic gray image detection method may malfunction, causing unwanted, periodic reinitialization of the camera. If the live video image is perdiodically flickering, then turning off this function may improve performance.
